name: Alleviate Addiction
body:
Source Black Markets pg. 19
School conjuration (healing); Level alchemist 1, cleric 1, druid 1, hunter 1, investigator 1, oracle 1, paladin 1, ranger 1, sahirafiyun 1, shaman 1, warpriest 1, witch 1
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF
Effect
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)
Description
The subject ignores the effects of addictions. The subject can naturally recover from damage dealt by the drug if she is under the effects of this spell for the entire duration of her rest.
